construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in this isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Exact keys: schema_version=1, fixture_label, question, sources, query, products, feedback. IDs are nonempty unique strings per collection. Source: id/text/credibility [0,1]. Product: id/name/description/tags/price >=0/available boolean. Feedback: id/product_id/text/rating null or [1,5]. Query: text/max_price null or >=0/limit integer [1,100].
shared_schema.output: Envelope: schema_version, status, stage, data. Data carries validated request and cumulative research, search, insights objects. Error envelope: status=error, error string.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validator enforces request structure, finite numbers, foreign keys, stage order, original evidence text, search eligibility and provenance, feedback selection, and theme count consistency. Every stage validates both its input and output.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated verbatim evidence IDs and up to 12 weighted source terms enrich query ranking.
Validated ranked selected product IDs restrict eligible feedback and preserve product and feedback provenance.

behavior.research: Unicode casefolded tokens and generic aliases; question-term coverage times supplied credibility ranks relevant sources. Source terms weighted by credibility yield needs; exact excerpts and limitations preserve evidence.
behavior.search: Alias normalization and deterministic vocabulary typo correction at similarity 0.84; score = 3 times query matches plus research matches. Hard availability and price filters. Score descending, price ascending, ID ascending ties; limit and positive-score restriction.
behavior.insights: Overlapping keyword themes; explicit ratings precede fallback lexical sentiment. Unknown themes fall into other. Negative count, volume, and theme name determine priority; actionable follow-ups retain feedback IDs.
behavior.errors: CLI emits one JSON error object with exit 2 for validation, usage, malformed JSON, encoding, and file failures.
behavior.fixtures: All example products, sources, and feedback are clearly labeled synthetic.

coverage: CLI success, usage, file and parsing failures
